angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the record's radius at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 5231963962676292224: parallax 11.5659 +/- 0.0187 mas (RUWE 0.91), inverted to 86.4613 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Temperature 7750 +/- 250 K and mass 1.6 +/- 0.1 solar masses as Desgrange et al. (2022, A&A 664, A139; arXiv:2206.00425) tabulate them (Table 1, from Chauvin et al. 2018 and earlier work). No paper used here gives a radius, so it is Gaia DR3's FLAME value, 1.5211 solar radii (Creevey et al. 2023), a catalogue model value, not a measured disc: 1,058,237 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. GM from 1.6 solar masses times the JPL solar GM. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its colour is Gaia's spectrum of it.
